What Snorkel AI sells

  • Snorkel Data Series: Specialist training data and reinforcement learning environments (models learn by trying tasks and receiving scores).
  • Agentic Data Platform: Combines expert work with AI quality checks.
  • Specialized agents: AI agents built for business applications.
